notes: Pictures now live in the device's own storage instead of a 5MB pocket. Everything the app keeps used to go into localStorage, which Android caps at a few megabytes for a site however much room the phone has, and every chat photo, gallery picture, reference photo and pose thumbnail sat in it as text, a third larger than the file itself; a few dozen pictures filled it and the app then refused to save anything at all, which is what stopped poses from being added. Pictures now go to IndexedDB, which the same WebView lets grow to hundreds of megabytes on the device, and only the text stays where it was. Nothing else in the app knows the difference: the pictures are still there in memory, and the swap happens on the way to disk and back. The move is automatic and careful. The first save after this update copies every picture into the device store and only then takes it out of the old one, so a crash halfway loses nothing; a picture removed from the app is removed from the device a few seconds later; erasing all data now clears both stores; and Troubleshooting logs shows what is where, how much text in the old store and how many pictures and megabytes in the new one. If a device somehow has no such store, the app carries on exactly as before and says so in the log.
